name: 19720 · New Castle, DE
findings: ZIP 19720 (New Castle) has 230 nonprofit organizations. 88 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 74 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19720 (New Castle) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 27 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
